answer: Treat every agent as a vertex in a payment graph and anchor trust at a few long-audited seed agents. Each epoch, short random walks spread reputation outward along edges weighted by settled, fee-paying trades. A Sybil cluster can forge thousands of nodes, but it only gains the trust that leaks through its few honest edges, so the attacker must buy real counterparties and pay real fees for every link instead of minting fakes for free.
